_about: Names in common use that are NOT in the official record. Kept by hand; the record itself is never edited.
The site shows an entry as 'commonly called ...' under the bill's own title, and makes it searchable.
Set "lead": true to put the common name first, with the bill's own title beneath it.
An entry is used only when "approved" is true, and only John sets that. Every entry needs a "source":
a link showing the name in real use (a major outlet, the sponsor's office, Congress.gov, CBO).
Candidates waiting for approval are listed in nickname_candidates.md.
